scope: Post-hoc, same-objective diagnostic control on all 120 previously frozen procurement pools. No new dataset, holdout or literature baseline.

greedy.eligible_budget: unselected j with total anchor cost <= the frozen budget
greedy.tie: Maximum score, then lower individual anchor cost, then lower anchor ID. No outcome-dependent tie change.
greedy.stop_budget: No eligible anchor or maximum exact single-anchor gain equals zero.
greedy.stop_precision: W(S)<=2r; otherwise no eligible anchor or maximum exact single-anchor gain equals zero.
greedy.negative_gain: Assert impossible by monotonicity; do not use tolerance.
greedy.zero_gain: Do not add an anchor when maximum single-step gain is zero, even if a two-anchor completion could improve precision. Record any such stall separately.
greedy.feasibility_diagnosis: Compare to global minimum W in all 64 subsets; distinguish genuinely unreachable thresholds from greedy stalls on globally reachable thresholds.
greedy.label: Cost-efficiency greedy (diagnostic control)

retention: All 120 pools, 240 budget cells, and 480 precision requests; exact optimum and original JB-RobustD records preserved unchanged.
metrics: Budget radius gap, relative width gap, exact optimum tie rate, chosen support size, complete greedy trace.
Precision feasibility counts including true infeasibility and greedy stall; anchor and total-cost excess against the exact optimum; total cost includes coarse cost+9*(1+anchor cost).
Summary by all six span/profile strata and thresholds; seed-cluster descriptive intervals with 20,000 resamples and seed2026093002; all conditions of a seed stay together.

Exhaustive two-anchor complementarity: for each S and unordered j,k outside S, Delta_jk(S)-Delta_j(S)-Delta_k(S), exact rational values. Save all strict-positive witnesses and all zero-single-gain/positive-pair-gain witnesses.

Optimal support-size distribution over 240 budget choices and 329 feasible precision requests; representative explanation fixed as seed840101 over all spans/profiles, without changing any main comparison.
claims: Greedy and complementarity analyses diagnose the cost of optimizing the same ambiguity objective without exact joint selection. They do not establish superiority over a published recent method, and their scenes are not new confirmation data.
